translation:
Say, Haruhi—what's your plan from here on
out?

All I care about is when this unproductive
summer camp is going to end.

Didn't I tell you? Our objective is to witness
unnatural phenomena with our own eyes.
We're not stopping until we do.

In that case, I get the feeling we'll be
continuing this camp for the rest of our lives.

Rest assured, as I—the brigade chief—will
be with you for every moment!

How is anyone supposed to rest assured
hearing that?
Not just Mikuru by your side, but me as well—
As a guy, you should be weeping with joy.

I guess in a certain way she's right, I do want
to cry.

The SOS Brigade supreme brigade
chief—that's me!

U-umm, I think you're a really incredible
person, Suzumiya—
What's this, all of a sudden?

Always thinking up unthinkable things to do…
even if they're a little troubling…
At first it was a little… you know…

But now I think I'm glad I was brought into the
SOS Brigade.
What an admirable attitude.

I'd love to let a certain someone hear you say
that.
Ahaha…

But you really are the best brigade chief,
Suzumiya.

Look, you don't need to go out of your way to
tell me.
I'm already very aware that I'm the best!
The best brigade chief.

To say you're the best would imply there are
other objects of comparison.
There's no such thing!

There is no brigade chief but supreme and
ultimate me!
Then the qualifier "best” is not appropriate.
You don't get it, Yuki.

The moment you're compared to someone else,
you can no longer claim to be the best.

Well, not that you'd ever understand if I just
explained it to you.
First, just take a gooood look at me.

Me and the way my SOS Brigade livens up the
world, that is!

Miss Suzumiya, I'd like to ask—what do you
mean by a brigade member's mental attitude?
That's obvious.

Keeping a close eye on me—the brigade
chief.
What do you mean?
Not just listening to what I have to say.
Always predicting what I'm thinking.

Occasionally you need to anticipate things
and prepare for them.

You're far superior to Kyon in that regard,
Koizumi.
Thank you very much.

But that's only because I'm keeping a vigilant
watch on the greatest brigade chief.

Yes, yes! You really get it, don't you! That's
what's so excellent about you.
